facts.claim: The Premier of Victoria's release of 3 March 2026 said that for the 2026 Grand Prix (5 to 8 March) more than 130 extra train services and 5,000 additional trams would run; tickets included free trams to Albert Park and free trains between Town Hall, State Library and Anzac; late-night services ran until 1:30am; trams from Southern Cross served Gates 1 and 2, a new tram corridor from Flagstaff via William Street served Gate 3, trams from Flinders Street and Town Hall served Gates 8, 9 and 10; extra buses ran Friday to Sunday between Crown Casino and Gates 1, 2 and 3; Lakeside Drive and surrounding Albert Park roads were closed with extra restrictions on Spencer Street, Bourke Street and St Kilda Road; routes 606, 246, 600, 922 and 923 continued.
